fields.cause: Tripped breaker; the unit was on a circuit shared with a space heater.

timeline.event: Alarm sounded; the first contact did not answer.
Clinic manager found the breaker tripped and reset it.
Product labeled do not use and moved to the hospital pharmacy unit.
Immunization program reached; viability answer requested.

products.basis: Scenario product table: usable after a documented excursion under 12 °C for under six hours.
Scenario product table: not usable above 8 °C; manufacturer line asked.

fields.decidedBy: Vaccine coordinator with the immunization program
fields.patientsAffected: 14 doses given between 02:40 and 06:05; recontact list prepared
fields.notified: State immunization program, vaccine manufacturer line, clinic medical director
fields.corrective: Dedicated circuit, generator transfer switch and a call tree with two named contacts.
